allocation_note: The 96+108+288+144+36 allocation below is the single recommendation. The earlier 144+216+216+96 split and the unpublished draft are not additive.

old_balance_policy.use: independent verification and failures only; not a complete new research stage

blocks.solves: Whether strong teacher, deterministic editor, or training-source references can produce feedback-derived, verified, training-qualified correction trajectories and select the direct-solver or repairer deployment contract.

Whether local-edit E beats matched full-program R and neutral N from the same ordinary checkpoint under equal task coverage, visible information, label quality and rehearsal. O remains frozen and reused only when its input contract is unchanged.

Whether O/N/R/E retain their ordering on 24 exposure-clean families with three task variants after the pre-generation exposure-union guard returns no overlap. No generation is allowed if overlap is found.
One matched repeat for the winning R/E pair on the same frozen protocol and source split. It is reserved before confirmation results are inspected.
Bounded interface, teacher, source-qualification or accounting failures. Unused reserve remains unused.

decision_after_request.continue: E must exceed R on qualified correction and retain an exposure-clean confirmation advantage without relying on excess abstention.
decision_after_request.stop: If E does not exceed R, or the gain disappears after matched teacher and training cost, stop the feedback-learning method candidate and retain it as a negative result.
decision_after_request.c3_stop_rule: Delivery repair remains stopped unless a candidate improves correct delivery over neutral retry without an offsetting increase in wrong delivery or abstention.
